tests.name: hash_numeric_types_equality
tests.intent: Verify that std::hash produces identical hash values for 0 stored as signed integer, unsigned integer, and floating-point number.

tests.name: unordered_set_numeric_collision
tests.intent: Verify that a std::unordered_set containing integer 0, unsigned 0, and float 0.0 correctly collapses them into a single unique element.

tests.name: hash_negative_zero
tests.intent: Verify that negative zero (-0.0) hashes to the same value as positive zero (0) and 0.0.

tests.name: hash_range_ends_signed_min
tests.intent: Verify hashing of minimum 64-bit signed integer INT64_MIN and its float representation.

tests.name: hash_range_ends_large_unsigned
tests.intent: Verify hashing behavior for large numbers near 2^63 stored as unsigned integers.

tests.name: hash_large_integers_collision
tests.intent: Verify that unequal large integers like 2^53 and 2^53+1 share a hash due to floating-point conversion precision limits.

tests.name: hash_non_numeric_distinctness
tests.intent: Verify that non-numeric types like null, boolean false, and integer 0 do not accidentally share the same hash values.

tests.name: hash_nested_containers
tests.intent: Verify that hashing works correctly on nested arrays and objects containing mixed numeric types.

tests.name: hash_string_type
tests.intent: Verify hashing of string JSON values for consistency.

tests.name: hash_boolean_true
tests.intent: Verify hashing of boolean true value.

tests.name: hash_empty_object
tests.intent: Verify hashing of an empty JSON object.

tests.name: hash_empty_array
tests.intent: Verify hashing of an empty JSON array.

tests.name: ordered_json_numeric_hash
tests.intent: Verify that nlohmann::ordered_json uses the same consistent numeric hashing behavior.

tests.name: hash_positive_float_variants
tests.intent: Verify hashing across float, double, and integer values that represent the same mathematical number.

tests.name: unordered_map_with_mixed_keys
tests.intent: Verify that a std::unordered_map using json keys allows lookup across mixed signed, unsigned, and float numeric types.

tests.name: hash_negative_numbers_consistency
tests.intent: Verify hash consistency for negative integers, unsigned-stored values, and floats.

tests.name: hash_binary_type
tests.intent: Verify hashing of binary JSON values.

tests.name: hash_deeply_nested_structure
tests.intent: Verify hash function execution on a moderately nested JSON structure.

tests.name: hash_max_unsigned_integer
tests.intent: Verify hash value of maximum unsigned 64-bit integer compared to its floating point conversion.

tests.name: hash_different_strings
tests.intent: Verify that different strings produce distinct hash values.
